description:
Purpose: Read the user's searchnapply subscription, its daily call limit and what was used today; it does not state a price, since prices are on the pricing page, and a value that is unknown is left out.
When: The user asks what their subscription costs, when the trial ends, or why a tool stopped answering.
Cost: About 50 tokens.
name: subscription_get

limits.description: The plan's limits; absent when Billing did not answer.

callsPerDay.description: How many tool calls the plan allows a day.

plan.description: The plan as Billing reports it.

renewsAt.description: The date the plan renews; present only when it renews.

status.description: The subscription status as Billing reports it.

trialEndsAt.description: The date the trial ends; present only on a trial.

dailyLimitReached.description: True when today's calls are spent; absent when Billing did not say.

tokensResetAt.description: The date the token allowance resets; absent when Billing does not report it.

tokensUsedPercent.description: The share of the month's token allowance used, in percent; absent when Billing does not report it.

title: Get my subscription
